title: Tower of Hanoi · 5 rings
success_criteria: Move all five rings from left to right while obeying legal-stack, placement, joint-limit, and penetration checks.
summary: A long-horizon manipulation task with a symbolic move grammar and strict physical placement checks.
notes: Five-ring Level 3 had one reported success in the Opus 5.5 run; Levels 1–2 are reported per attempt in results.json.

title: Hanoi atlas · Sharpa arm + hand
success_criteria: Run one of the 40 authored cases with native geometry, contact, and trajectory audits passing.
summary: Forty paired Hanoi configurations for a full arm-mounted Sharpa hand.
notes: The repository reports scene and randomized-condition validation, but no scored external agent result.

title: Hanoi atlas · floating Sharpa
success_criteria: Execute or inspect a full-size 40-case no-arm Sharpa Hanoi configuration under the shared Hanoi rules.
summary: A floating-hand variant that isolates finger coordination from arm motion.
notes: Catalog and regression evidence exist; this card does not imply an agent score.

title: 2×2 Pocket Cube · Dual ALOHA
success_criteria: Complete the declared interlocked face-turn sequence with legal carrier switching and no hard physical violation.
summary: A bimanual 2×2 cube with explicit interlock rules and switchable carriers.
notes: The repository has native scene and rule checks; there is no scored evaluator row in the Opus 5.5 report.

title: 2×2 Pocket Cube · Dual Sharpa
success_criteria: Complete the declared interlocked face-turn sequence while preserving bilateral contacts and carrier locks.
summary: A matched Sharpa counterpart to the Dual ALOHA 2×2 cube task.
notes: Scene initialization and rule checks pass, but no agent score is claimed.

title: 3×3 Rubik's Cube · Franka Panda
success_criteria: Execute measured quarter-turns and satisfy the hybrid-fixture mechanism and terminal state checks.
summary: A full-size cube environment where the agent must reason about faces, regrasping, and mechanism state.
notes: The public report includes scorer-regression failures and one agent_finish row; the U×4 clip is a privileged reference trajectory, not a solved-cube leaderboard.

title: 3×3 Rubik's Cube · floating Sharpa
success_criteria: Begin and execute a measured face turn through the Sharpa-compatible mechanism interface.
summary: A floating-hand cube track designed to expose dexterity and face-turn planning.
notes: The compact A3 clip is a single-turn calibration preview; the Opus 5.5 run reports mechanism_unavailable, so no complete solve is claimed.

title: Franka Marble · 100-scene campaign
success_criteria: Use the robot to load, aim, and release a marble; satisfy scene-specific target and physics rules within the four-trial protocol.
summary: A 100-scene, multi-shot benchmark inspired by Angry Birds, with physical structures and causal outcomes.
notes: Vision Level 3 has a preliminary Opus 5.5 result over 408 episodes. Sharpa is currently a separate grab-ball prototype, not a campaign score.

title: Angry Birds-inspired multi-level scenes
success_criteria: Clear the configured target(s) under indirect-damage, material, order, and limited-ammunition rules.
summary: Structured defenses, indirect effects, and material-specific rules turn a single shot into a causal planning problem.
notes: Treat level and controller checks as environment evidence; do not present them as external agent success.

title: Kongming lock · dual-arm assembly
success_criteria: Insert and release all six pieces with nine measured segments, stable final geometry, penetration, contact, and departure audits passing.
summary: A six-piece burr-lock assembly task with measured insertion corridors and independent physical scoring.
notes: Reference trajectories are labelled separately from Opus 5.5 agent attempts; fixed-state agent rows failed hard audits.

title: Kongming lock · dual-arm disassembly
success_criteria: Detach all six pieces, park them in distinct zones, release, stabilize, and clear both arms under the independent scorer.
summary: Reverse extraction of the same lock tests contact sequencing and collision-aware manipulation.
notes: The site includes a Dual Franka reference disassembly trajectory; fixed-state agent rows and scorer contradictions remain documented separately.

title: Kongming lock · floating Sharpa
success_criteria: Demonstrate a documented floating-hand extraction or insertion route under a Sharpa-specific control contract.
summary: An experimental floating-hand extension for the lock family.
notes: A06/D06 are native fixed-camera acceptance/reference previews; no Opus 5.5 agent score is claimed.

title: Tabletop micro-skills
success_criteria: Complete the configured articulated-object or tabletop manipulation goal without violating the task contract.
summary: A set of short-horizon probes for opening, grasping, pouring, switching, rotating, and relocating.
notes: These are environment entries and capability probes, not agent benchmark scores in the current results file.

title: Bookshelf organization
success_criteria: Move books into a target shelf layout while preserving ordering, support, and collision constraints.
summary: A candidate multi-object organization benchmark from the feature branch.
notes: The task is intentionally marked candidate until the branch is merged and scored in the public benchmark protocol.

title: Desk organization
success_criteria: Define an auditable tabletop arrangement goal and complete it without object loss or forbidden contact.
